name: Ki Reservoir
body:
Your mastery over ki is so Great you are actually able to use more ki than should be possible. While others are limited by their physical body, your ki knows no such constraints.

Prerequisite(s): Con 14, Ki pool class feature, Ki Harness

Benefit: The number of points in a your ki pool is equal to your his monk level + his Wisdom modifier.

Normal: The number of points in a monk’s ki pool is equal to 1/2 his monk level + his Wisdom modifier.
